::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

<!-- This include deliberately does NOT load interactive/figures.css,
     plotly-cartesian.min.js, or qmrust_wasm.js. Its only consumer,
     chapters/ch10-demo-qmrlab.qmd, already pulls all three in through
     includes/fig-t1-equations.qmd, which sits earlier on that page.
     Loading qmrust_wasm.js a second time is not merely wasteful: the file
     opens with a top-level `let wasm_bindgen`, and a redeclaration in the
     global lexical scope is a SyntaxError that kills the second script.
     If this figure is ever used on a page without fig-t1-equations.qmd,
     those three tags have to come back. -->

<div class="qmrust-figure">

<p id="q-status" style="font-size:12px;color:#6a6a6a;margin:0 0 10px"></p>

<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;overflow-x:auto">
  <div id="q-curves" style="flex:1 1 430px;min-width:400px"></div>
  <div id="q-maps"   style="flex:0 0 250px"></div>
</div>

<div style="margin:10px 0 0;max-width:660px">
  <label for="q-ti" style="font-size:13px">Inversion time TI = <b><span id="q-tival">1.00</span> s</b></label>
  <input id="q-ti" type="range" min="0.01" max="5" step="0.01" value="1" style="width:100%">
</div>

<p class="caption">Left: longitudinal magnetization for three tissues, long-TR inversion recovery, magnitude.
The three T<sub>1</sub> values are the cluster means of the map on the right, so each curve's
null marks the TI at which that tissue goes dark in the image. The map has been recalibrated onto
literature T<sub>1</sub> values, since the VFA fit reads high and increasingly so with T<sub>1</sub>. The dotted line marks the selected TI; moving it does not change the curves.
Right: the inversion-recovery image produced at the selected TI, voxel by voxel, from a
T<sub>1</sub> map that qMRust fitted from a variable-flip-angle acquisition ahead of time. The
inversion-recovery signals themselves are computed by qMRust in WebAssembly as the page loads.</p>

</div>

<script src="interactive/data-t1map.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var TNR = "Times New Roman";
  var CFGP = { showLink: false, displayModeBar: false, responsive: true };
  /* The VFA fit of this dataset reads high, and not by a constant factor:
     k-means (k=3) over its 4668 fitted voxels gives 1.12 / 1.85 / 3.57 s where
     3 T literature is about 0.90 / 1.35 / 4.00 s. VFA's bias grows with T1, so
     a single multiplier cannot fix both ends -- it would leave CSF near 2.9 s.
     Instead the map is warped through those three control points with a
     monotonic piecewise-linear curve, which is what a T1-dependent calibration
     actually looks like. The curve values below are the anchors themselves, so
     the nulls on the left still mark where the image on the right goes dark.
     This is a pedagogical recalibration, not the raw fit. */
  var ANCHOR = [                    // [fitted, target] in seconds
    [0.00, 0.00],
    [1.12, 0.90],                   // white matter
    [1.85, 1.35],                   // grey matter
    [3.57, 4.00]                    // CSF
  ];
  function remapT1(x) {
    for (var i = 1; i < ANCHOR.length; i++) {
      if (x <= ANCHOR[i][0]) {
        var x0 = ANCHOR[i-1][0], y0 = ANCHOR[i-1][1];
        var x1 = ANCHOR[i][0],   y1 = ANCHOR[i][1];
        return y0 + (y1 - y0) * (x - x0) / (x1 - x0);
      }
    }
    var n = ANCHOR.length - 1;      // extrapolate along the last segment
    var sx0 = ANCHOR[n-1][0], sy0 = ANCHOR[n-1][1];
    var sx1 = ANCHOR[n][0],   sy1 = ANCHOR[n][1];
    return sy1 + (sy1 - sy0) / (sx1 - sx0) * (x - sx1);
  }
  var TISSUES = [
    { label: "White matter",        T1: ANCHOR[1][1] },
    { label: "Grey matter",         T1: ANCHOR[2][1] },
    { label: "Cerebrospinal fluid", T1: ANCHOR[3][1] }
  ];
  var TI_MAX = 5, NTI = 400;            // TI samples for the drawn curves
  var NLUT = 150;                       // TI samples for the image lookup
  var NBIN = 100;                       // T1 bins for the image lookup
  var MODE = "magnitude";               // this figure shows |Mz| only

  /* ---- thin qmrust wrappers (recipe/forward are private to app-ir.js) ---- */
  function recipe(ti, method) {
    return "model: inversion_recovery\nmethod: " + method + "\n" +
           "inversion_times: [" + ti.map(String).join(", ") + "]\n";
  }
  function forward(cfg, t1, a, b) {
    return JSON.parse(wasm_bindgen.forward(cfg, new Float64Array([t1, a, b]), "", ""))
             .map(function (s) { return s.value; });
  }
  function decodeBase64(b64) {
    var bin = atob(b64), n = bin.length, out = new Uint8Array(n);
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i); }
    return out;
  }
  function grid(flat, nx, ny, offset, stride) {
    var out = new Array(ny);
    for (var i = 0; i < ny; i++) {
      var row = new Array(nx);
      for (var j = 0; j < nx; j++) { row[j] = flat[offset + (j * ny + (ny - 1 - i)) * stride]; }
      out[i] = row;
    }
    return out.reverse().map(function (r) { return r.reverse(); });
  }
  function linspace(a, b, n) {
    var o = new Array(n), d = (b - a) / (n - 1);
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { o[i] = a + i * d; }
    return o;
  }
  function axis(extra) {
    return Object.assign({ showline: true, linecolor: "black", mirror: false,
      ticks: "outside", tickfont: { family: TNR, size: 13 }, zeroline: false }, extra || {});
  }

  var tiGrid  = linspace(0.001, TI_MAX, NTI);
  var lutTi   = linspace(0.001, TI_MAX, NLUT);
  var curves = {};      // mode -> [ [y per tissue], ... ]
  var lut = {};         // mode -> Float64Array(NBIN * NLUT)
  var T1map = null, nx = 0, ny = 0, maskArr = null;
  var BBOX = null;   // tight crop around the mask
  var t1Lo = 0.05, t1Hi = 5.0;

  /* ---- one-time Rust work -------------------------------------------------
     forward() takes a whole list of inversion times, so the entire TI axis for
     one T1 costs a single call. Precomputing a T1-bin x TI table here keeps the
     slider instant; per-voxel-per-TI calls would be ~16k per slider tick.

     The cost is essentially linear in NBIN x NLUT, because forward() hands its
     result back as JSON and the serialise/parse dominates. So the table gets a
     coarser TI axis than the curves do: the three curves are what the reader
     actually reads values off, and they are only three calls, so they keep the
     fine grid. The table only has to look right as a grayscale image, where
     NBIN sets how finely T1 is banded and NLUT how finely the slider steps. */
  function precompute() {
    [MODE].forEach(function (m) {
      var cfgCurves = recipe(tiGrid, m);
      curves[m] = TISSUES.map(function (t) { return forward(cfgCurves, t.T1, 1.0, -2.0); });
      var cfgLut = recipe(lutTi, m);
      var table = new Float64Array(NBIN * NLUT);
      for (var b = 0; b < NBIN; b++) {
        var T1 = t1Lo + (t1Hi - t1Lo) * (b + 0.5) / NBIN;
        var y = forward(cfgLut, T1, 1.0, -2.0);
        table.set(y, b * NLUT);
      }
      lut[m] = table;
    });
  }

  /* The VFA fit is not redone here. utility/precompute-t1map.js runs the same
     qMRust fit_volume offline and writes interactive/data-t1map.js, so the page
     loads 47 kB of fitted T1 rather than 277 kB of raw VFA volume. It arrives as
     raw fitted T1 in seconds, float32, masked voxels only in flat-index order;
     the recalibration above stays here, where it is visible and can be retuned
     without regenerating the data. */
  function loadT1Map() {
    nx = T1MAP.dims[0]; ny = T1MAP.dims[1];
    maskArr = decodeBase64(T1MAP.mask);
    var fit = new Float32Array(decodeBase64(T1MAP.t1).buffer);
    T1map = new Float64Array(nx * ny);
    for (var v = 0, k = 0; v < T1map.length; v++) {
      if (maskArr[v]) { T1map[v] = remapT1(fit[k++]); }
    }
  }

  /* The acquisition FOV is mostly empty around the head. Crop to the mask's
     bounding box so the brain fills the panel rather than a black border. */
  function computeBBox() {
    var m = grid(maskArr, nx, ny, 0, 1), pad = 2;
    var r0 = 1e9, r1 = -1, c0 = 1e9, c1 = -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < m.length; i++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < m[i].length; j++) {
        if (m[i][j]) {
          if (i < r0) r0 = i; if (i > r1) r1 = i;
          if (j < c0) c0 = j; if (j > c1) c1 = j;
        }
      }
    }
    if (r1 < 0) { BBOX = null; return; }
    BBOX = { r0: Math.max(0, r0 - pad), r1: Math.min(m.length - 1, r1 + pad),
             c0: Math.max(0, c0 - pad), c1: Math.min(m[0].length - 1, c1 + pad) };
  }
  function cropGrid(g) {
    if (!BBOX) { return g; }
    return g.slice(BBOX.r0, BBOX.r1 + 1).map(function (row) {
      return row.slice(BBOX.c0, BBOX.c1 + 1);
    });
  }

  /** Synthetic IR image at one TI, read out of the precomputed Rust table. */
  function irImage(ti) {
    var k = Math.round((ti - lutTi[0]) / (lutTi[1] - lutTi[0]));
    k = Math.max(0, Math.min(NLUT - 1, k));
    var table = lut[MODE], out = new Array(T1map.length);
    for (var v = 0; v < T1map.length; v++) {
      if (!maskArr[v] || !Number.isFinite(T1map[v]) || T1map[v] <= 0) { out[v] = null; continue; }
      var b = Math.floor((T1map[v] - t1Lo) / (t1Hi - t1Lo) * NBIN);
      b = Math.max(0, Math.min(NBIN - 1, b));
      out[v] = table[b * NLUT + k];
    }
    return out;
  }

  function drawCurves(ti) {
    var traces = TISSUES.map(function (t, i) {
      var name = "T<sub>1</sub> = " + t.T1.toFixed(2) + " s (" + t.label + ")";
      return { x: tiGrid, y: curves[MODE][i], mode: "lines", name: name, text: name,
               hoverinfo: "x+y+text" };
    });
    var yTitle = "|M<sub>z</sub>|";
    Plotly.react("q-curves", traces, {
      width: 430, height: 330, margin: { l: 55, r: 8, b: 50, t: 10 },
      xaxis: axis({ title: { text: "Inversion Time – TI (s)", font: { family: TNR, size: 15 } } }),
      yaxis: axis({ title: { text: yTitle, font: { family: TNR, size: 15 } },
                    range: [0, 1.05] }),
      // About as low as it goes: the CSF curve's right-hand tail reaches
      // |Mz| = 0.43 at TI = 5 s, which is y = 0.41 on this axis.
      legend: { x: 1, y: 0.41, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "bottom",
                font: { family: TNR, size: 11 }, bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.75)" },
      shapes: [{ type: "line", x0: ti, x1: ti, yref: "paper", y0: 0, y1: 1,
                 line: { color: "#444", width: 1.5, dash: "dot" } }],
      plot_bgcolor: "white", paper_bgcolor: "white"
    }, CFGP);
  }

  function drawMaps(ti) {
    var blank = { showgrid: false, zeroline: false, showticklabels: false, ticks: "" };
    // The T1 map supplies the per-voxel T1 the inversion-recovery image is
    // computed from; it is not itself displayed.
    var traces = [
      { type: "heatmap", z: cropGrid(grid(irImage(ti), nx, ny, 0, 1)),
        colorscale: [[0, "rgb(0,0,0)"], [1, "rgb(255,255,255)"]],
        zmin: 0, zmax: 1,
        colorbar: { title: { text: "|S|", side: "top", font: { family: TNR, size: 13 } },
                    thickness: 7, len: 0.72 },
        hovertemplate: "|S| = %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>" }
    ];
    Plotly.react("q-maps", traces, {
      width: 250, height: 330, margin: { t: 30, r: 2, b: 6, l: 2 },
      annotations: [
        { text: "IR image at TI = " + ti.toFixed(2) + " s", x: 0.5, y: 1.10,
          xref: "paper", yref: "paper", showarrow: false,
          font: { family: TNR, size: 15 } }
      ],
      xaxis: Object.assign({ domain: [0, 0.88] }, blank),
      yaxis: Object.assign({ domain: [0, 1], scaleanchor: "x" }, blank),
      plot_bgcolor: "white", paper_bgcolor: "white"
    }, CFGP);
  }

  function redraw() {
    var ti = parseFloat($("q-ti").value);
    $("q-tival").textContent = ti.toFixed(2);
    drawCurves(ti);
    drawMaps(ti);
  }

  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    if (typeof Plotly === "undefined") { $("q-status").textContent = "Plotly failed to load."; return; }
    $("q-status").textContent = "Starting qMRust…";
    wasm_bindgen({ module_or_path: "interactive/qmrust_wasm_bg.wasm" }).then(function () {
      $("q-status").textContent = "Precomputing signal tables in Rust…";
      setTimeout(function () {
        var t0 = performance.now();
        precompute();
        $("q-status").textContent = "Loading the precomputed T₁ map…";
        setTimeout(function () {
          loadT1Map();
          computeBBox();
          $("q-status").textContent = "Ready — inversion-recovery signals computed in " +
            "Rust/WebAssembly in " + (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(0) + " ms";
          redraw();
          $("q-ti").addEventListener("input", redraw);
        }, 20);
      }, 20);
    }).catch(function (e) {
      $("q-status").textContent = "qMRust failed to start: " + e;
      console.error(e);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
